<!-- ═══════════════ CONFERENCE SERIES ═══════════════ -->
<section>
  <div class="section__head">
    <div>
      <div class="section__label">Conference series</div>
      <div class="section__title">Recurring series relevant to emissivity <em>research</em>.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="inner-page" style="max-width:52rem; line-height:1.7; color:var(--text-secondary,#555);">
    <p>The following recurring conference series regularly feature sessions, papers, or workshops on emissivity, radiative properties, infrared thermography, and temperature metrology:</p>

    <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:1rem; font-size:0.9rem;">
      <thead>
        <tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #1b3a6b; text-align:left;">
          <th style="padding:0.5rem;">Series</th>
          <th style="padding:0.5rem;">Focus</th>
          <th style="padding:0.5rem;">Frequency</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>QIRT</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Quantitative infrared thermography &mdash; calibration, emissivity measurement, NDT</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Biennial</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>ECTP</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">European Conference on Thermophysical Properties &mdash; thermal conductivity, diffusivity, emissivity</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Triennial</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>TEMPMEKO</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">International symposium on temperature, humidity, moisture, and thermal measurements in industry and science</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Triennial</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>SPIE ThermoSense</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Thermal infrared applications and thermography</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Annual</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>NEWRAD</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">New developments and applications in optical radiometry</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Quadrennial</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>ITS</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">International Temperature Symposium</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">~Every 4 years</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>IMEKO World Congress</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">International Measurement Confederation &mdash; metrology across disciplines</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Triennial</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>CIM</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">International Metrology Congress &mdash; measurement science and applications</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Biennial</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>IHTC</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">International Heat Transfer Conference &mdash; radiative heat transfer sessions</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Quadrennial</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>IR-EMPOWER</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Workshop and network coordination for emissivity measurement in Europe</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Annual</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;"><strong>ITCC/ITES</strong></td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">International Thermal Conductivity Conference / Thermal Expansion Symposium</td>
          <td style="padding:0.5rem;">Annual</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>
